points.description: Names the Maxwell–Betti reciprocal theorem (Betti's law / Maxwell's reciprocal theorem of reciprocal deflections/work).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only 'Maxwell' or only 'Betti' (or 'reciprocal theorem' without a name) is given, or the name is slightly garbled but clearly recognisable as one part.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming the Maxwell-Betti reciprocal theorem; accept 'Betti's theorem' with 'Maxwell's reciprocal theorem' or equivalent wording naming both. Give 1 mark if only Maxwell's or only Betti's theorem, or just 'reciprocal theorem', is stated. Give 0 for other theorems (e.g. Castigliano, superposition) or unrelated answers.
